items.html: It was already explained there, too, that what Atik selected the first time was to correct the very self of the Partzuf of Arich Anpin at the beginning of its correction, and he gave them to Arich Anpin as Mochin. And from these Hesed and Gevura (HaG) that Atik gave to Arich Anpin the first time, the Partzuf of Arich Anpin, male and female, was built and corrected, and they remained there permanently, forever fixed. And when Arich Anpin, in turn, selects for the sake of Aba ve Ima, to correct them the first time, then the coupling of Atik, male and female, must first precede it, and they return to draw new Mochin to Arich Anpin and Nukva, so that they may select the selections of the parts of Aba ve Ima. Then the new HaG come to them: the Hasadim from MA and the Gevurot from BON. And then, within Arich Anpin, the parts of Aba ve Ima are corrected there, as mentioned there. Thus there are two kinds of Hasadim and Gevurot: the first are the original ones, to correct the Partzuf; the second are the new ones that are drawn in each and every coupling, each and every time, which do not remain there permanently, but are corrected and formed into the shape of an offspring, and are born there.
